# Generic array transfers with independent unbounded contexts

A method-owned array component binds the original input and opaque returned array.
A complete Class<?> context supplies no component constraint. Source and SDK paths
retain scalar widths, exact array and token identities, callback mutations, checked
and unchecked throwable identity, covariant stores, delayed array casts and caller
casts. Tokens may be null, primitive, void or unrelated to the actual returned
component. Four frozen invocation paths run 216 fresh cases twice; sixteen wrong
programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the observations. Every
emitted source and original class/method role, Signature and Exceptions is checked.
